'''Aiqin 4''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Aiqin 4 system]], which was found in the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] staged an attack in the [[Star system/Legends|system]] to capture the [[Airam (group)|Airam]] clan leader [[Ilay]], who was attempting a peace settlement with the Empire that would cost the Alliance the planet. When the Rebels succeeded in [[Battle of Aiqin 4|capturing]] the clan leader, they were able to [[Battle of Nocto|repel]] Imperial forces at [[Nocto system/Legends|Nocto]] and fortify the [[Sector/Legends|sector]].
